name: uxr-intake
description: Guided UX research intake for EGYM. Sharpens a research question, recommends a rigorous method, checks prior studies, drafts the study itself, hands Lyssna studies over as a ready-to-build sheet or a browser-agent prompt, runs a heuristic evaluation when an expert review is the smarter first step, and writes the finished brief into the UXR Roadmap in Notion.
